metadata.description: Full address of the private 1-to-1 site, e.g. https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site> (no trailing slash).
The Team Leader's email address. Receives submissions and problem reports.

Initialize_varTestDate.description: Leave empty in production. For a test run, e.g. 2026-11-20T07:00:00

Check_setup_has_run.expression: @or(equals(outputs('Ids')?['owners'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['fullControl'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['edit'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['read'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['reviewsList'], null), equals(outputs('Ids')?['mgrList'], null))

STOP_run_the_setup_flow_first.inputs: @int('The 1-to-1 permission levels or Owners group were not found. Run ESG 1-to-1 | 0 Setup first.')

inputs.name: varProblems
inputs.value: @concat(items('Each_technician')?['Title'], ': more than 10 active expectations – only the first 10 by SortOrder were used.')

inputs.value: @concat('FAILED for ', items('Each_technician')?['Title'], ' – no email was sent. Open the run history for details.')

inputs.where: @and(contains(createArray(outputs('Today'), outputs('In7')), if(contains(string(coalesce(item()?['NextReviewDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(item()?['NextReviewDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(item()?['NextReviewDate'], ''))), not(empty(item()?['CompletedOn'])), contains(body('Active_tech_emails'), toLower(coalesce(item()?['Technician']?['EMail'], '#none'))))

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Wellbeing review @{if(equals(if(contains(string(coalesce(items('Each_review_due')?['NextReviewDate'], '')), 'T'), formatDateTime(convertFromUtc(coalesce(items('Each_review_due')?['NextReviewDate'], '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z'), 'GMT Standard Time'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), coalesce(items('Each_review_due')?['NextReviewDate'], '')), outputs('Today')), 'due today', 'due in 7 days')}: @{items('Each_review_due')?['Technician']?['Title']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
